input.question: Where was Deodato primarily active in his career?

documents.text: active in Lucca and Pisa between 1284 and 1315 . He primarily painted religious-themed works on commissions for churches . Some of his works show a Byzantine art style , and an influence of Giotto can also be seen . He painted frescos for the San Piero a Grado church which was commissioned by the Caetani family for the 1300 jubilee .
